# ponte_recert_policy (Resource)

A recertification review policy: who reviews a campaign's agents, in how many steps, by when, and what happens at the deadline and on a denial. A policy that a schedule or rule uses cannot be destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_recert_policy" "quarterly" {
  name = "Quarterly access review"

  reviewer      = "owner"
  second_review = "high_risk"
  second_group  = "security"

  due_days       = 14
  remind_days    = 3
  on_overdue     = "escalate"
  escalate_group = "security-leads"
  on_deny        = "suspend"

  auto_certify = [
    { field = "risk_tier", op = "eq", value = "low" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique in the organisation.

### Optional

- `auto_certify` (Attributes List) Agents matching every condition are certified without review. Never applied to an agent with no owner or with access recommended for removal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_certify))
- `due_days` (Number) Days each item has before its deadline. 0 is no deadline.
- `escalate_days` (Number) Days the escalation group has. Defaults to 7 when on_overdue is escalate.
- `escalate_group` (String) The group an overdue item is escalated to, for on_overdue escalate.
- `fallback_group` (String) Who reviews agents that have no owner. Empty uses the service default.
- `on_deny` (String) A denial: revoke (credentials and grants) or suspend (reversible).
- `on_overdue` (String) At the deadline: keep_open, escalate, suspend or revoke.
- `remind_days` (Number) Send a reminder this many days before the deadline. 0 sends none.
- `reviewer` (String) Who reviews: owner (the agent's owner), group or person.
- `reviewer_ref` (String) The group or person, for reviewer group or person.
- `second_group` (String) The group that decides the second step. Never the person who approved the first.
- `second_review` (String) A second step after the first reviewer certifies: none, all or high_risk (agents of risk tier high or critical).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The policy id (rp_…).

<a id="nestedatt--auto_certify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_certify`

Required:

- `field` (String) An agent field, e.g. risk_tier, stale_days, entitlement_count.
- `op` (String) eq, ne, in, lt or gt, as the field allows.
- `value` (String) The value; comma-separated for in.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ponte_recert_policy.quarterly rp_0123456789ab
```
